[list]
[*] New Mutation Store with fresh mutations!
[*] Mutation Mode now supports multiplayer! (Includes Weekly Mutant and Mutation Store)

[h2]Fellow Animal Crusaders, you've been waiting![/h2]
[h3]The new big version [Abandoned Lab]. is officially coming -[/h3]

[i]“Recently, some strange cluckmechs have appeared in animal shop, quickly attracting the Animal Expedition ......
Meanwhile, Animal Crusaders whose attack in volcano was blocked, found some strange tracks while looking for a breakthrough.Two sides converge the clues, and the routes turn out to be strikingly similar!

As they follow the trail, the animals realize that the root of it all seems to point somewhere ......”[/i]


[h3]In the new version V1.2.0 "Abandoned Lab," players can experience the following content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brand new scene: [Abandoned Lab], offering richer adventures and exploration areas
[*] 6 new enemies + the Lab Boss, introducing the "shut down" mechanic for a more thrilling defense experience
[*] Now supports[b]controllers[/b]&SteamDeck！Enjoy a more flexible gaming experienc!
[*] 8 exclusive research lab-themed cluckmechs + over 30 enhancement paths, offering more diverse combo strategies
[*] New general enhancements and reworks, along with cluckmech adjustments, offering more build combinations and entirely new chicken-mech experiences
[*] New [b]stats interface[/b], [b]re-roll feature[/b], and various new systems to enhance gameplay experience
[/list]
Thanks to your continued support!
We have super ideas we want to share with you! Come join the group and discuss!



[h2][Abandoned Lab][/h2]

[b]Brand new scene--[Abandoned Lab][/b]

You can access it after clearing the swamp/glacier, and it's leveled with the scorched incense volcano ([u]needs to be unlocked after clearing level 5 once time[/u])
*After the 1st time through level 5, the first 3 games will definitely be Abandoned lab

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/ff52bd1758984d7ccaf5224b9fde8005b336fcfc.png[/img]
[i]The plants invade the mechanical facility and seem to awaken some unearthly ability![/i]

[list]
[*] Some enemy attacks cause the cluckmech to temporarily  “shutdown”
[*] Shutdown cluckmechs will not be attacked by enemies, and Guardians, Warriors, etc. will not be able to attract enemies
[*] Shutdown cluckmech cannot attack or move.
[/list]

That's a tricky ability, Animal Crusaders, watch out--

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/d7a37fe80222399e98b91fba31fdcbf9ba77f1d3.gif[/img]


[b]New Enemies & Bosses - The enemies are surprisingly![/b]

Parasitic Turret&Parasitic Scarecluck
[list]
[*] What the hell is going on at this institute? Discarded cluckmechs parasitized by [Bean Sprout] are all over the place!
[*] The parasitized Turret always likes to patrol between walkways, using splinters and nails as bullets to attack!
[*] The parasitized Strawcluck uses the long Vineman as legs to walk fast! Even if you defeat it, the remains of the strawcluck as a host will still block bullets! Very difficult to deal with.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/045a489249ecb739a4688f4b6e633ef70efaf0f1.gif[/img]


Apache Helisprouter
[list]
[*] A cluster of sprouts parasitizing ‘flowerpots’ sacrifices their own health to hurl berserk sprouts. It seems that Mad sprout have electronic chips implanted in their bodies, making them incredibly fierce. Upon death, they trigger an EMP explosion causes cluckmech shutdown!
[*] It's a big threat to the line and must be dealt with as soon as possible!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/5bab0793d3aa8cd3b39999873fb749a24cfc1059.gif[/img]


Frankenburger
[list]
[*] An evil scientific creation, a bio-weapon made from a combination of plants. However, due to the rough modifications, it fires five powerful projectiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/1c073bad1f43f689f1d3fbf3e30c8cecc29aac8c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/e27a06e241cd40110253e4c0b9d62959d8dcb729.png[/img]

That's all the intel brought back by the front line's investigative mission ......
[u]More unknown enemies[/u] will require everyone in the Animal Crusaders to explore and deal with!

notes.title: [IMPORTANT]When game closes abnormally, resulting in corrupted archives.
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, everyone[/h2]
After 2 days on sale，We have received a lot of feedback from players that the game is causing [b]dead files[/b] after the computer crashes, blue screens, and game fast disappear，The second time you enter the game, you cannot "Continue" or "New Game".We are currently in the process of resolving the issue as soon as possible, and you can start by choosing the following options to deal with it -


[h2]Method settle an issue:[/h2]
[h3]①. Don't start the game directly after the game closes abnormally.[/h3]
    (Make sure you don't start the game straight away!)

[h3]②. if you don't start the game directly.                            If you have already started the game, please go to (③)[/h3]

[b]1.        Follow the steps below to enter the Steam Cloud Archive management interface:[/b]
Help→Steam Support→My Account→Data Related to Your Steam Account→in"Uploaded Content"find"Steam Cloud"→find"cluckmech oasis",click Show Files→ Download all archive files 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/b7b2af3695d76d705915fe2c3bfbd31a2fe80daa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/f947ca07ceafadac0238aef19da08989385976cc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/c6dbbe2a3e9ac15e6cbd192dfa4f9bd6791e0f2c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/f06e3bf055f050f2f1f63bef66e7cd132a93e6f7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/2939fc2bf81322e270dc04e990306fcb53aae0b1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/87c0ac4d0a931d84c69e6bd1c35131fba1613ba2.png[/img]

[b]2.        Rename the downloaded archive file to the following name:[/b]

The .qjcd suffix is named quanju_m.qjcd
If you have a file with a .cd extension, name it danju_m.cd.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/4fd63c67a225180282ac1c6157a6860e103c2e28.png[/img]

[b]3.        Move and paste the downloaded and renamed archive files into this directory:[/b]
C:\Users\你的用户名\AppData\LocalLow\BlackLight\Cluckmech Oasis
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/3dc3a19906a6ad1ff663541ac4a73579e8b4ae55.png[/img]

[b]4.        Open the game and check to see if it's back to normal.[/b]

[h3]③,If you start the game straight away and are unable to click new or continue:[/h3]
Unfortunately, you may not be able to recover your game archive.
This is mainly due to:
1),The game was shut down abnormally during the archive writing process and the archive data was corrupted.
2),Steam Cloud Archive Synchronization, will upload and download the cloud archive once when the game starts, your corrupted archive may have been synchronized to Steam's cloud archive server, and overwrite your normal healthy archive.
Steam doesn't offer the ability to compare cloud archive data or trace the history of individual archive files, and we're not very good at that.

[h3]However, you can still clean up the corrupted archive and start a brand new adventure by doing the following:[/h3]

[b]1.        Launch the game and enter the main menu screen[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/3c7054047cf6283fb865015c98aec4e286ef5178.png[/img]
[b]2.        Launch the game and enter the main menu screen[/b]
C:\Users\你的用户名\AppData\LocalLow\BlackLight\Cluckmech Oasis

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/671365a7b0434f98512047036f361c4329341a10.png[/img]
[b]4.        Start the game and begin a brand new adventure![/b]


[h2][We are also looking for better solutions!][/h2]
[b]We've heard from players who have crashed, lost power, shut down, or had their computer shut down in an unusual process that resulted in a broken file.
We are doing everything we can to avoid this problem! A later update will reduce the probability of complete archive corruption![/b]
